nodes.question: How does AI impact job markets and economic equality according to the text?
nodes.answer: AI has the potential to significantly disrupt job markets, with experts noting that up to 40% of working hours could be impacted, leading to job losses and potentially exacerbating existing economic inequalities if not properly controlled.
